clue.text: Sudden move by directors to establish target

parts.note: to dart is to make a sudden quick movement
a company's directors sit together as its board

explanation.surface: A boardroom coup: the directors make a sudden move to set up a target.
explanation.definitionFit: A dartboard is the circular target at which darts are thrown in the pub game.

clue.text: Recruit departs military service, needing support of course

parts.note: D is the timetable abbreviation for departs
the RAF, Royal Air Force, is a branch of Britain's armed services
on a golf course the ball is supported on a tee for the opening shot

explanation.surface: A new soldier leaves for national service, needing support along the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' suggests a training course, but it is a golf course, where a tee holds up the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A draftee is a person conscripted into the forces, a recruit by compulsion.

clue.text: Administer sports event

definitions.meaning: to ... a business is to manage or administer it
a ... is a race, such as a fun ... or a cross-country event

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to manage something and a race on foot, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Queen Mary's husband is able to drink in here on journey?

parts.note: Mary II reigned jointly with William III, popularly called King Billy
can means is able to

explanation.surface: A historical question: could King William manage a drink while travelling?
explanation.walkthrough: Queen Mary here is Mary II, whose husband and co-monarch William of Orange is remembered as King Billy.
explanation.definitionFit: A billycan is a metal pot used by campers and Australian bushmen to boil tea on the trail.

clue.text: Greek's storage space?

definitions.meaning: Athenian, belonging to the region around Athens, as in the classical dialect of that name
a loft room under the roof where things are stored

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the adjective for ancient Athens and its region, and the room under a roof used for storage.

clue.text: Princess's reason for misery? Admitting love in conversation

parts.note: Di is Princess Diana, so Di's is the princess's

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the zero for love goes inside the misery word

parts.note: a curse is a cause of misery or affliction
love is nil in tennis, written as O

explanation.surface: A princess blames her unhappiness on love, which she confesses in a chat.
explanation.definitionFit: Discourse is formal or extended talk between people, a synonym of conversation.

clue.text: Expression of disapproval about church showing filmstrip

indicators.note: about means going round, so the disapproving word surrounds the church abbreviation

parts.note: fie is an old exclamation of disgust or disapproval

explanation.surface: Someone tuts disapprovingly about a church screening a film.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiche, short for microfiche, is a sheet of film carrying tiny photographed pages.

clue.text: Collapse as female totally exhausted

parts.note: all in is an idiom for completely worn out

explanation.surface: A woman keels over because she is utterly worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: When a roof or tunnel gives way it is said to fall in, meaning cave in or collapse.

clue.text: Literal form of belief disseminated by a minister and co.

indicators.note: disseminated means spread about, so the letters of these words are scattered into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A doctrine spread by a clergyman and his associates.
explanation.definitionFit: Creationism holds that the Genesis story of the world's making is literally true, a belief taken word for word.

clue.text: Muse quietly in swaying tree south of country club?

indicators.note: in a down entry south of means placed below, so after the club letters

parts.note: the EU, European Union, is a club whose members are countries

indicators.note: in means the soft letter goes inside the rearranged tree
a swaying tree moves about, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A poet muses quietly in a tree blowing in the wind beyond the golf club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country club' is not a golf club: the European Union is a club of nations. 'swaying' gives TERE and 'in' admits the quiet letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Euterpe is one of the nine Muses of Greek myth, presiding over music and lyric poetry.

clue.text: Ring to cancel engagement on vacation

parts.note: to annul is to declare void or cancel

indicators.note: vacated means emptied, so only the outside letters of the word are kept

explanation.surface: A ring sent back after calling off an engagement while on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: An annulet is a small ring, especially a ring-shaped moulding in architecture or heraldry.

clue.text: Stranger occupies street, striking

indicators.note: to occupy a place is to sit inside it, so the stranger goes within the street abbreviation

parts.note: an alien is a foreigner or stranger

explanation.surface: A newcomer takes over a road, and it is a remarkable sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Salient means prominent or most noticeable, as in the salient points of an argument.

clue.text: Small American city shown on casual shirt

indicators.note: in an across entry, one piece on another means it follows it

parts.note: a tee is a T-shirt
NY is New York

explanation.surface: A tiny New York slogan printed on a T-shirt.
explanation.definitionFit: Teeny is an informal word for very small or tiny.

clue.text: Philosophers met crisis, being confused about Greek character

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the jumbled letters go round the Greek letter
confused means mixed up, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: Thinkers in a crisis are bewildered about a Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being confused' yields EMRICISTS, and 'about' wraps it round the Greek letter; the surface hides that the philosophers are the definition, not the subject.
explanation.definitionFit: Empiricists are thinkers such as Locke and Hume who hold that knowledge comes from experience.

clue.text: Rhetoric's put off singer

indicators.note: put off can mean disturbed or set out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vocalist is deterred by fancy speechmaking.
explanation.definitionFit: A chorister is a member of a choir, especially a church choir, so a kind of singer.

clue.text: Hence more beautiful, one elucidates?

definitions.meaning: read as ..., someone who used to be plainer and so is now better looking
a person or thing that makes something clear

explanation.walkthrough: The first half is cryptic: split the answer as EX (former) and PLAINER, so a former plainer is, therefore, prettier now.
explanation.definitionFit: An explainer is a person, or an article, that clarifies or elucidates a subject.

clue.text: Disgraceful men with admissions of debt, following revolutionary fashion

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the debt notes come after the reversed fashion word
revolutionary means turning round, so the fashion word is read backwards

parts.note: ton is an old word for fashion or style
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers
an IOU, I owe you, is a written admission of a debt

explanation.surface: Shameful soldiers run up debts while chasing a radical trend.
explanation.walkthrough: TON for fashion is old-fashioned, as in 'the ton' of Regency society; 'revolutionary' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Notorious means well known for something bad, so infamous or disgraceful.

clue.text: English following fake set of rules

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the English letter goes after the fake word

parts.note: cod is an informal word for mock or fake, as in a cod accent

explanation.surface: An English sham passed off as a rulebook.
explanation.walkthrough: COD as an adjective meaning sham or bogus is British slang, as in a cod Irish accent.
explanation.definitionFit: A code is a systematic body of laws or rules, as in the highway code.

clue.text: Grunt in short strenuous game gaining speed

indicators.note: gaining means acquiring, so the speed unit is added on after the game
short means cut off at the end, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: hard means demanding or strenuous
RU is rugby union
MPH, miles per hour, is a measure of speed

explanation.surface: A player grunts during a tough, brief match that is picking up pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the D from HARD to leave HAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Harrumph is the sound of clearing one's throat in disapproval, a gruff grunt.

clue.text: Members of advisory team brought back for newcomer

indicators.note: brought back means returned, so the picked letters are read backwards
members are parts, so the letters are taken from within these words

explanation.surface: Some of the advisers are recalled to make way for a beginner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Members of' picks ORYT from advisORY Team, and 'brought back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyro is a beginner or novice, someone new to an activity.

clue.text: Fabric, shoddy stuff provided to clothe nude

indicators.note: clothing something wraps it, so the cheap stuff goes round the naked word

parts.note: tat is cheap, shoddy goods
bare means naked or nude

explanation.surface: Cheap cloth is supplied to cover a naked figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabaret is a silk upholstery fabric with alternating satin and watered stripes.

clue.text: A priest — he could concoct restorative treatments

indicators.note: to concoct is to make up by mixing, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A clergyman who might brew up healing remedies.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapies are treatments intended to heal or restore health.

clue.text: Partitioned country split by eastern power

indicators.note: split by means broken open, so the other letters go inside the country word

parts.note: a state is a nation or country
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: A nation divided by an Eastern superpower.
explanation.definitionFit: Septate is a biological term for divided by a septum, a dividing wall or partition.

clue.text: Nameless desire harboured by the female in cloak

indicators.note: harboured means sheltered within, so the shortened desire sits inside the female pronoun

parts.note: she refers to the female

indicators.note: nameless means without N, the abbreviation for name

parts.note: want means desire

explanation.surface: An anonymous longing kept secret by a woman wrapped in a cloak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nameless' removes N from WANT, leaving WAT.
explanation.definitionFit: To swathe is to wrap or envelop, so cloak in its verb sense.

clue.text: Defenders protecting part of town in retreat?

indicators.note: protecting means surrounding as a guard, so the defenders go round the town division

parts.note: in football or hockey, backs are the defending players
a ward is an electoral division of a town

explanation.surface: Defenders guarding a district while falling back.
explanation.definitionFit: Going backwards is moving in the reverse direction, as an army in retreat does.

clue.text: Like girl almost slipping up in dance

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means read from bottom to top, reversing the letters

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: almost means not quite complete, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A girl nearly takes a tumble on the dance floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' leaves LAS, and 'slipping up' turns ASLAS round; 'Like' is the comparison word, not a verb of fondness.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a lively Latin American dance and its music.

clue.text: Once again plan modern music to entertain them

indicators.note: to entertain guests is to take them in, so the music word holds the other piece

parts.note: rap is a modern style of music
'em is a casual shortening of them

explanation.surface: Planning again, using contemporary tunes to amuse an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: To remap is to map or plan out a second time.

clue.text: Dish knocked over by German gentleman

parts.note: Otto is a typical German man's name
sir is the form of address for a gentleman

clue.text: Sheepish type approaching girl for dance

Ada is a girl's name

clue.text: Beard starts to annoy wife normally

indicators.note: starts are beginnings, so the first letter of each word is taken

explanation.definitionFit: An awn is the bristly beard on an ear of barley or other grass.

clue.text: Sample artist's penultimate piece in gallery

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside the gallery name

parts.note: the Tate is the famous London art gallery
the second-to-last letter of the word artist

explanation.surface: Viewing a painter's next-to-last work on show in a gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: To taste is to try a little of something, as in sampling food.

clue.text: Investigation not right, brief rage leads to profound shift

indicators.note: not means without, so the right letter is removed

parts.note: a search is an investigation

indicators.note: brief means cut short, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: anger means rage

explanation.surface: An inquiry going wrong and a burst of temper bring about a major change.
